name: var_granite_b_1
what: warm-grey speckled granite slabs. A new variant of the attached texture (the last image before the grid, from my game): exactly the same colours, the same SIZE of rounded slabs and flecks, the same crevice darkness, light and contrast; only the arrangement of the slabs differs, so this tile and the original side by side don't look like a repeat. Seamless on all four edges, every cell filled. Variant 1 of 3: a clearly different layout from the other variants.
